independence_note: 40 source-labeled test files; 39 unique inputs; one unique test input also occurs in training. Not 40 independent held-out samples.

comparison.detections_note: Summed case outputs, not unique independent biological cells.
comparison.max_delta_scope: Exact-center matched polygons; all winner centers matched in this run.

raster_outlier.limitation: Legacy winner paint order is unavailable for this image. Independent polygon/union pixel changes are not an original exclusive-label differing-pixel count.

tensor_limit: Most original TF1 probability/distance arrays were not retained; this run makes no tensor-tolerance comparison.

timing_seconds.initial_setup_note: These workflow steps precede the timed runner; their individual durations are not recorded in this artifact.
timing_seconds.scope: CPU worker includes fresh JVM/model loading, normalization, tiling, inference and GATO write; geometry includes NMS, measurements and compact outputs.

protocol.preprocessing: Unchanged production CSBDeep normalization/tiling; no additional image resizing/cropping.
protocol.exact_conversion: Pillow decodes one unsigned 8/16-bit scalar TIFF plane; preserve numerical pixels (palette TIFFs retain scalar palette indices, as in the original NumPy conversion); cast exactly to big-endian float32 row-major GATI v1; no color, intensity, size, or axis transformation.

retention.all_case_geometry_and_outliers: All40 original case.json, actual.geometry.json, outliers.json, compact masks/outlines and logs remain byte-preserved as the indicated ZIP members.

independent_audit.limitation: Independent raster/geometry and provenance audit; no raw tensor parity or missing-order legacy reconstruction.
